<thought>Search the template catalog for an SN2-like retrosynthetic template that breaks a halide bond and forms a carbon‑nucleophile (amine) bond, matching the given target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amine"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
